$comment: NXP AN12196 (NTAG 424 DNA and NTAG 424 DNA TagTamper features and hints), the two AuthenticateEV2First worked examples, as published test data. Both use the factory-default all-zero AES key: it is no secret, and it lives here as data rather than as a key literal in the code. The bytes were taken from the transcription in the ntag424 crate 0.1.1 (MIT OR Apache-2.0, https://codeberg.org/jannschu/ntag424: src/session/tests.rs, src/commands/authenticate/aes.rs, src/crypto/suite.rs), which cites AN12196 for each; the application note itself was not fetched. Replayed by household/src/ntag424.rs tests::an12196_* and simulator_matches_an12196_key0. All values are hex.

key0.$comment: Key 0x00, Table 14: the full APDU transcript.

key3.$comment: Key 0x03: part 2 APDU, card response, TI, session vector and session keys.
